# Invoicerr

> Open-source invoicing app (AGPL-3.0): quotes, invoices, payments and e-invoicing to the tax office. Country rules ship for France, Germany, Italy, Poland and Portugal. Self-host it free with Docker or Helm, or use the hosted cloud version.

This site's full text, home page and every page below, is in [llms-full.txt](https://invoicerr.app/llms-full.txt). The product documentation has its own index at [docs.invoicerr.app/llms.txt](https://docs.invoicerr.app/llms.txt).

## Product

- [Product](https://invoicerr.app/#product): from quote to invoice, payment matching and legal archive
- [Countries](https://invoicerr.app/#countries): what the app asks and sends for each supported country
- [Self-hosting](https://invoicerr.app/#hosting): Docker image for amd64, arm64 and arm/v7, and a Helm chart
- [Pricing](https://invoicerr.app/#pricing): per-company cloud pricing, self-hosting free

## Guides

Country-specific e-invoicing guides, each written in its own country's language for that country's
audience: no product comparison, every date and threshold sourced to the legal text or the tax
administration.

- [Facturation électronique en France](https://invoicerr.app/facturation-electronique): who must receive and issue electronic invoices, from when by company size, what a PDP is, accepted formats and archiving duration
- [E-Rechnung in Deutschland](https://invoicerr.app/e-rechnung): who is concerned, the 2025 to 2028 phase-in, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats, and the eight-year archiving duration
- [Fatturazione elettronica in Italia](https://invoicerr.app/fatturazione-elettronica): who is concerned, mandatory since 2019 with the forfettari regime added in 2022 and 2024, the Sistema di Interscambio and FatturaPA format
- [KSeF w Polsce](https://invoicerr.app/ksef): who must use Poland's national e-invoicing system, the turnover-staged mandate and its current dates, the FA(3) format and archiving duration
- [Faturação eletrónica em Portugal](https://invoicerr.app/faturacao-eletronica): the ATCUD code, certified invoicing software, SAF-T (PT) reporting and retention duration

## Hosted version

- [Waiting list](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/): the hosted version opens in November 2026. The page states plainly that billing runs in Polar's sandbox during the beta, that the legal documents are still marked as drafts, and that invoices issued from the beta must not be used for real. Also written in [French](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/fr/), [German](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/de/), [Italian](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/it/), [Polish](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/pl/) and [Portuguese](https://invoicerr.app/waitlist/pt/).
